headline: Raelene Polymiadis Convicted Of Murdering Parents With Insulin
seoTitle: Raelene Polymiadis Found Guilty Of Parents' Murder
metaDescription: A South Australian jury has found Raelene Polymiadis guilty of murdering her elderly parents by administering insulin, resulting in two life sentences.
aiSummaryBullets: A jury in the South Australian supreme court convicted Raelene Polymiadis of murdering her parents.
The 66-year-old woman was found to have used insulin to kill her 94-year-old parents.
The conviction follows a legal trial that spanned several months.
aiContextParagraph: A jury in South Australia has reached a unanimous verdict in the murder trial of Raelene Polymiadis, aged 66. Following a legal process that lasted for several months, Polymiadis was found guilty of murdering her two parents, who were both 94 years old. According to the evidence presented during the proceedings at the South Australian supreme court, the defendant utilized insulin to commit the act. Following the jury's decision, the defendant faces two mandatory life sentences. The case attracted attention due to the duration of the trial and the nature of the evidence presented against the defendant. The court proceedings concluded on Friday, with reports confirming the unanimous verdict. The defendant, who is diabetic, was described as having used the medication as a weapon against her elderly parents. No further information regarding the sentencing date or specific trial developments has been provided by the current reporting outlets.
